params.body:
## Why

`resources/views/ownstock/` still carried Bootstrap grid and form markup next to the migrated Livewire vehicle sheet. This is the first of a series that moves the own-stock views to the Tailwind/`ui-` vocabulary with identical behaviour: same field names, ids, `onclick` handlers and JS hooks. This PR takes the modals and the XML confirmation page.

Modals keep their `.modal` shell on purpose: `resources/js/modal.js` (the vanilla controller) shows and hides by that markup and the `data-toggle`/`data-dismiss` triggers, and `modal.get()` fragments are appended as-is. Only the body and footer moved to `ui-field`, `ui-form-grid`, `ui-form-actions`, `x-ui.button` and `x-ui.file`.

## Reachability (step 1, whole directory)

| View | Status |
|---|---|
| `XMLimportModal` | used: included by `livewire_preview` (own-stock list) and classic create |
| `XMLconfirmation` | used: `OwnStockController::createFromXML` |
| `_modals/showroomaffiche` | used: `AfficheController::check` returns it as html, `modal.open()` on the list |
| `_modals/sold` | **unused**: route `ownvehicle.update.sold_modal` is only referenced by the `$lw=false` branch of `_wagen_rij`, which no view includes any more (`ownstock/index.blade.php` is gone); the Livewire list has its own sold modal |
| `in_option_modal` | used: `ownvehicle.create.isinoption` (list row action, sheet status bar) |
| `propose_modal` | used: `ownvehicle.propose.modal` (list row action, buybox) |
| `createCarVweModal` | used: included by `vehicle_form_preview`, classic create/edit, worklist widget |
| `vehicle_form_preview` | used: `ownvehicle.create` / `ownvehicle.edit` when `features.livewire_vehicle_form` is on (staging) |
| `_tabs/general`, `_tabs/prices`, `_tabs/_inspection_dates`, `_tabs/options`, `_tabs/extras` | used: included by `livewire/vehicle-form` (`lw => true`) and classic create/edit |
| `_tabs/damage`, `_tabs/photos` (+ `photos/image`, `photos/stocklist`, `photos/sl_image`) | used: Livewire islands (`$renderIslands`), `getPhotoTab`, `ImageController` |
| `_tabs/damages`, `_tabs/_damage_media` | used: rendered by `OwnStockController::addDamage` (ajax) and inside `_tabs/damage` |
| `_wagen_rij` | used: `livewire/own-stock-list` (`lw => true`); its `$lw=false` branches are dead |
| `edit`, `create`, `_tabs/dates`, `_type_veld`, `header` | **classic fallback only**: served when `LIVEWIRE_VEHICLE_FORM` is off (the config default). `header` is a no-op inside `XMLconfirmation` (`@if(!isset($xml_filename))`) and its `$vehicles` branch is dead |
| `showroom*` | out of scope (just redone) |

## What per view

- `XMLimportModal`: native file input (`x-ui.file`, `ui-file`) in a `ui-field`, submit in `ui-form-actions`; `aria-labelledby` now points at the real title id. Form id/name and field name unchanged.
- `XMLconfirmation`: `ui-page-head` with a back link (the old `@include('ownstock.header')` rendered nothing here), two panels in a Tailwind grid, `ui-list` tables with `thead`/`tbody` and `data-label` so the phone gets the card layout. Fixes the old markup that put every new vehicle in one row (no `<tr>`). Submit button keeps `id="search-average"`.
- `_modals/showroomaffiche`: footer buttons only; poster logic untouched.
- `in_option_modal`: the three inputs drop `form-control`, the save button is `x-ui.button`. `addDays`, `#until_date`, `#days`, `.close` handler and `inoption_submit_button` unchanged.
- `propose_modal`: footer buttons and the hint line (`ui-field-help`); combobox and form unchanged.
- `createCarVweModal`: `ui-form-grid--2` for chassis number + tokens, `ui-form-actions ui-vin-actions` for the busy line + import button; all hooks kept (`plateOnly`, `chassis_number_warning`, `chassis_number_error`, `cardna-errormessage`, `ui-vin-busy`, `createCarVweFormButton`, `for_export_modal_input`, `vehicle_id`). `refresh.css`: the `#create-carVwe-modal-form .row:has(...)` rules are replaced by `.ui-vin-actions`.

## Unused candidates (not deleted here)

- `_modals/sold.blade.php` (with `vehicle.saveSold` in `resources/js/vehicle/vehicle.js` and route `ownvehicle.update.sold_modal`)
- the `$lw=false` branches of `_wagen_rij.blade.php`
- `header.blade.php`'s `$vehicles` branch, and `edit`/`create`/`_tabs/dates`/`_type_veld` once the Livewire sheet is confirmed on in production
- Finding, not changed: the "print anyway" button in `_modals/showroomaffiche` calls `doShowroomprint(false)`, which the Livewire list page does not define (it was defined by the classic index). Kept as is; worth a follow-up.

## Screenshots

Before/after at 1280 and 390 (test kernel + Playwright, fixture admin): `tw-ownstock-{before,after}-{propose,inoption,list-xml,sheet-vin,xml}-{1280,390}.png` in the session scratchpad.

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` + `php -l` on every compiled touched view
- `php artisan test --filter='SmokeTest|CompiledViewsTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|VehicleForm|Vehicle'`: green (local MySQL `forge_test`)
- `npm run build`
params.title: Own stock modals: XML import, in-option, propose, VWE on the ui vocabulary
